summary: Frontend-only UI test for the NEW staff email invitation feature in /pracownicy edit modal. All 10 scripted steps passed 10/10 against the deployed Expo web preview. Full flow verified: initial 'Nie zaproszony' status → fill email 'biesiadapodlasem+ui-test@gmail.com' → invite-send-btn → blue 'Zaproszenie wysłane · <email>' + 'Ważne do ...' + resend/cancel buttons appear and send button hides → invite-resend-btn keeps sent state → invite-cancel-btn triggers a native window.confirm ('Anulować zaproszenie? Link z e-maila przestanie działać.') → after accept, status reverts to 'Nie zaproszony' and invite-send-btn reappears.
